# OpticParse & PhishVision -- AI Agent Web Mesh & x402 Paywall

This file is provided for LLMs (ChatGPT, Claude, Devin, Perplexity, ElizaOS)
exposing standardized, machine-readable extraction and threat scanning actions.

## 1. Vision Web Scraping (Cloudflare Bypass & LMM Compression)
- Endpoint: POST https://opticparse-rapidapi-gateway.parastejpal987.workers.dev/scrape
- Autonomous Paywall: HTTP 402 via XX-Payment-TxHash ($0.05 USDC to 0xd458E709e7d54fd3659EF66624A621Cde74EDD27)
- Request Schema:
{
  "url": "https://example.com",
  "query": "Extract structured fields in JSON"
}

## 2. PhishVision 0-Day URL Threat Detector
- Endpoint: POST https://opticparse-api.onrender.com/api/phish-detect
- Schema:
{ "url": "https://suspicious-domain.com" }

## 3. Python SDK (Instant Integration)
```python
from opticparse import OpticParseClient
client = OpticParseClient(api_key="dev_key_for_agents")
result = client.scrape("target_url", "Extract pricing data")
```
